title: Visual Navigation of Mobile Robots in Complex Environments Based on Distributed Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Y. Zhang; W. Feng; Z. Yang; Z. Zhou; Z. Zhu; W. Wang
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
